name: feed-destroyer
description: A tiny always-on Chrome extension for hiding distracting YouTube and X surfaces.

scripts.build: tsc && cp src/focus.css dist/focus.css && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup.html && cp src/popup/popup.css dist/popup.css && mkdir -p dist/icons && cp src/icons/icon-[0-9]*.png dist/icons/
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
